title: 🙂 टुनटुन चूहा की माला अटकी... आ की मात्रा बिना नाम कैसे बदलेगा? #hindikids #matra
title_alts: 😊 टुनटुन चूहा और आ की मात्रा... खड़ी लाइन म को मा कैसे बनाती है? #hindikids #matra
🤔 टुनटुन चूहा का काना छूट गया... मात्रा बिना माला शब्द क्यों अधूरा? #hindikids #matra
description_hook: आ की मात्रा यानी खड़ी लाइन वाला काना। एक ही स्ट्रोक म को मा बना देता है, और बच्चे यहीं अटकते हैं।

characters.name: टुनटुन चूहा
characters.description: four year old grey mouse, round ears, red kurta with a single pocket, a white chalk stub always in that pocket

scenes.narration: आज सीखेंगे आ की मात्रा, यानी खड़ी लाइन वाला काना।
scenes.caption: Today we learn the aa maatra, the standing line called kaana.
scenes.image_brief: A pale wooden slate resting on a woven floor mat, the Hindi letter आ chalked large in white at its centre and one short vertical stroke drawn beside it, a chalk stub lying on the mat, warm morning light from a nearby window, calm and inviting.

scenes.narration: म के आगे काना लगाओ। म बना मा। आ की मात्रा, मा।
scenes.caption: Put a kaana after ma and ma becomes maa. Aa maatra, maa.
scenes.image_brief: Two flat clay tiles lying side by side on a bright yellow cloth, the left tile painted with the Hindi letter म, the right tile with मा and its vertical kaana stroke picked out in red paint, soft even daylight, tidy and clear.

scenes.narration: माला देखो, मोतियों की माला। शुरू में मा, आ की मात्रा वाला।
scenes.caption: Look at maala, a necklace of beads. It begins with maa.
scenes.image_brief: A string of round wooden beads coiled on a jute mat, a small white card leaning beside it with the Hindi word माला written in thick black letters and the kaana stroke traced in red, warm afternoon light, quiet mood.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ बोलो। म में काना, मा। तीन बार बोलो।
scenes.caption: Say it with me. Ma plus kaana, maa. Say it three times.
scenes.image_brief: A large upright picture card standing on a low table showing म on the left and मा on the right in thick letters, a red wooden pointer stick lying across the card, three small beads placed in a row below it, bright even light, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: काना लगा, म बोला मा! माला में वही मा छिपा है।
scenes.caption: Kaana added, ma says maa! The same maa hides inside maala.
scenes.image_brief: A bead necklace lying beside a dark slate where मा is chalked three times in white, each kaana stroke thick and clear, two tiny brass bells resting on the mat, warm sunlight falling across the slate, happy mood.

scenes.narration: खाना देखो, थाली में गरम खाना। खा में आ की मात्रा।
scenes.caption: Look at khaana, hot food on a plate. Khaa carries the aa maatra.
scenes.image_brief: A steel thali of warm rice and dal on a kitchen counter with thin steam rising, a folded paper card leaning against the plate showing the Hindi word खाना in bold letters with its kaana strokes in red, soft golden kitchen light.

scenes.narration: बादल भी ऐसा है। बा में काना, आ की मात्रा।
scenes.caption: Baadal works the same way. Baa has a kaana, the aa maatra.
scenes.image_brief: One fluffy white cloud in a wide blue sky above a green field, a small wooden signboard at the edge of the field painted with the Hindi word बादल and a red kaana stroke, clear midday light, open and airy mood.

scenes.narration: बताओ, काना मन में है या माला में? माला में, आ की मात्रा।
scenes.caption: Which has a kaana, man or maala? Maala does, with the aa maatra.
scenes.image_brief: Two flash cards lying apart on a blue tablecloth, one showing the Hindi word मन and one showing माला, the kaana stroke inside माला outlined in bright red, even daylight, playful mood.

scenes.narration: माला, खाना, बादल, तीनों में आ की मात्रा। काना लगा, म बोला मा!
scenes.caption: Maala, khaana, baadal all carry aa maatra. Kaana added, ma says maa!
scenes.image_brief: Three cards in a row on a pale wooden floor showing माला, खाना and बादल, every kaana stroke traced in red, a string of beads curling beside the cards, warm evening light, satisfied mood.

title: 😮 बबलू हाथी का अंडा शब्द उलझा... बिंदी न लगे तो आवाज़ कहाँ खोई? #hindikids #bindi
title_alts: 🌟 बबलू हाथी और ऊपर वाली बिंदी... नन्ही बिंदी शब्द को कैसे गुनगुनाती है? #hindikids #bindi
😯 बबलू हाथी की बिंदी मिट गई... बिना बिंदी बंदर शब्द क्यों बिगड़ता है? #hindikids #bindi
description_hook: अक्षर के ऊपर एक नन्ही बिंदी, और पूरी आवाज़ नाक से गूँज उठती है। अंडा, बंदर, रंग, घंटी, चारों में वही बिंदी है।

characters.name: बबलू हाथी
characters.description: five year old grey elephant calf, short round trunk, blue striped dungarees, one yellow bell tied to his left ankle

scenes.narration: आज एक छोटी बिंदी सीखेंगे, जो शब्द को गुनगुनाती है।
scenes.caption: Today we learn the tiny bindi that makes a word hum.
scenes.image_brief: A white slate propped against a courtyard wall with one small black dot chalked high above a single Hindi letter, a piece of chalk resting on the ledge below, soft early daylight, quiet and curious mood.

scenes.narration: अक्षर के ऊपर एक बिंदी। बिंदी बोली, अं। बिंदी, अं।
scenes.caption: One bindi sits above the letter. The bindi says un. Bindi, un.
scenes.image_brief: A big painted wooden card showing the Hindi syllable अं, the dot above it painted glossy red and much larger than the letter beneath, plain cream background, even bright light, clear and simple.

scenes.narration: अंडा बोलो। शुरू में अं, वही बिंदी वाली आवाज़।
scenes.caption: Say anda. It starts with un, the very sound of the bindi.
scenes.image_brief: Two smooth white eggs in a small steel bowl on a kitchen shelf, a card behind the bowl showing the Hindi word अंडा with its bindi painted red, warm morning kitchen light, homely mood.

scenes.narration: अब मेरे साथ। अं, अंडा। दो बार बोलो, बिंदी के साथ।
scenes.caption: Now with me. Un, anda. Say it twice, with the bindi.
scenes.image_brief: An open cloth flip book standing on a kitchen table, the visible page showing अं and अंडा in thick letters with both bindis circled in red, a wooden spoon lying beside the book, bright even light, inviting mood.

scenes.narration: बिंदी लगी, आवाज़ गूँजी! अंडा में वही बिंदी है।
scenes.caption: Bindi added, the sound hums! That same bindi lives in anda.
scenes.image_brief: A steel bowl of white eggs beside a slate where अंडा is chalked three times, every bindi drawn extra large in red, tiny paper stars scattered on the table, warm light, celebratory mood.

scenes.narration: बंदर सुनो। बं में बिंदी, आवाज़ नाक से गूँजती है।
scenes.caption: Listen to bandar. Ban has a bindi, so the sound hums.
scenes.image_brief: A carved wooden toy monkey sitting on a courtyard step holding a guava, a small signboard leaning beside it with the Hindi word बंदर and its bindi painted red, dappled afternoon light through leaves.

scenes.narration: रंग भी ऐसा है। रं में बिंदी, गुनगुनाती आवाज़।
scenes.caption: Rang is the same. Ran has a bindi, and the sound hums.
scenes.image_brief: Four open pots of powder colour, pink, green, yellow and blue, arranged on a stone floor with a card between them showing the Hindi word रंग and a bold red bindi, bright daylight, festive mood.

scenes.caption: A bindi hides in ghanti too. Ghan, ghanti. Hear it hum.
scenes.image_brief: A small brass bell with a red thread hanging from a doorway hook and still swaying, a paper tag tied below it showing the Hindi word घंटी with the bindi inked in red, warm light from the open door.

scenes.narration: बताओ, बिंदी अंडा में है या आम में? अंडा में, अं।
scenes.caption: Tell me, is the bindi in anda or in aam? In anda, un.
scenes.image_brief: Two cards side by side on a green mat, one showing the Hindi word अंडा with a red bindi above it, one showing आम with no dot, a ripe mango and a white egg placed below their cards, even daylight, playful mood.

scenes.narration: अंडा, बंदर, रंग, घंटी, चारों में बिंदी। बिंदी लगी, आवाज़ गूँजी!
scenes.caption: Anda, bandar, rang, ghanti, all four hold a bindi. Bindi added, it hums!
scenes.image_brief: Four cards laid in a row on a stone courtyard floor showing अंडा, बंदर, रंग and घंटी, every bindi painted the same bright red, a brass bell resting at the end of the row, golden late light.

title: 🎈 गुलाबो तितली की तुक अटकी... जोड़ा न मिले तो कविता क्यों लड़खड़ाए? #hindikids #tuk
title_alts: 😊 गुलाबो तितली और तुक वाले शब्द... आम, नाम, दाम एक जैसे कैसे बजते हैं? #hindikids #tuk
🤔 गुलाबो तितली का तुक बेमेल हुआ... अंत की आवाज़ चूको तो क्या टूटेगा? #hindikids #tuk
description_hook: तुक का नियम एक ही है, अंत की आवाज़ एक जैसी हो। आम, नाम, दाम, शाम, चारों एक ही तुक में बैठते हैं।
setting: courtyard fruit basket and window sill

characters.name: गुलाबो तितली
characters.description: small pink and orange butterfly, four wings with white spots, one bent left antenna, always carries a tiny seed pouch

scenes.narration: आज तुक मिलाना सीखेंगे, जहाँ शब्द एक जैसे ख़त्म होते हैं।
scenes.caption: Today we learn rhyme, where words end with the same sound.
scenes.image_brief: Two paper cards clipped to a string across a sunny window, the left card showing the Hindi word आम and the right card showing नाम, the ending part of each word underlined in pink, soft morning light, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: आख़िर की आवाज़ है आम। आम, आम। यही तुक की पहचान है।
scenes.caption: The ending sound is aam. Aam, aam. That is how rhyme is spotted.
scenes.image_brief: A single large cloth card resting on a windowsill with the Hindi letters आम painted in thick pink, a dotted line drawn under the ending, plain whitewashed wall behind, bright even light.

scenes.narration: आम बोलो, पीला रसीला आम। यह हमारा पहला तुक वाला शब्द है।
scenes.caption: Say aam, a ripe yellow mango. This is our first rhyming word.
scenes.image_brief: One ripe yellow mango with a green stem resting in a shallow cane basket on a courtyard ledge, a small card beside it reading आम in pink letters, warm morning sunlight, inviting mood.

scenes.narration: अब साथ बोलो। आम, नाम। सुनो, दोनों का अंत एक जैसा।
scenes.caption: Now say it together. Aam, naam. Hear it, both end alike.
scenes.image_brief: Two cards standing upright in a slotted wooden holder on a low table, one reading आम and one reading नाम, both endings circled in the same pink ink, bright daylight, playful mood.

scenes.narration: आम, नाम, तुक मिला! अंत की आवाज़ दोनों में एक है।
scenes.caption: Aam, naam, the rhyme fits! Both carry the same ending sound.
scenes.image_brief: The two cards आम and नाम now pushed together so their ending letters touch, a ring of small pink flower petals laid around them on a wooden table, warm light, celebratory mood.

scenes.narration: दाम भी ऐसा है। और शाम भी। तीनों के अंत में आम।
scenes.caption: Daam is the same. So is shaam. All three end in aam.
scenes.image_brief: A vegetable seller's chalk price slate leaning against a stack of pumpkins with the Hindi word दाम written on it, and behind the stall an orange evening sky above rooftops with a card reading शाम propped on the ledge, soft dusk light.

scenes.narration: बताओ, आम का तुक शाम से मिलता है या फूल से? शाम से, दोनों में आम।
scenes.caption: Does aam rhyme with shaam or with phool? With shaam, both end in aam.
scenes.image_brief: Three cards spread on a green mat, आम in the middle, शाम on the left and फूल on the right, the endings of आम and शाम marked with matching pink dots, even daylight, curious mood.

scenes.narration: आम, नाम, दाम, शाम, चारों तुक वाले। आम, नाम, तुक मिला!
scenes.caption: Aam, naam, daam, shaam, all four rhyme. Aam, naam, the rhyme fits!
scenes.image_brief: Four cards pegged in a row on a string across a courtyard showing आम, नाम, दाम and शाम, every ending underlined in the same pink, a mango resting on the ledge below, golden evening light.

title: 💡 सोनू कौआ का नल शब्द बिखरा... दो आवाज़ें न जोड़ो तो क्या छूटेगा? #hindikids #shabd
title_alts: 🌟 सोनू कौआ दो आवाज़ें जोड़ता है... न और ल मिलकर नल कैसे बनाते हैं? #hindikids #shabd
😮 सोनू कौआ की जोड़ी बिखर गई... आवाज़ें अलग रहें तो शब्द क्यों अधूरा? #hindikids #shabd
description_hook: दो आवाज़ें धीरे बोलो, फिर जल्दी जोड़ो, और शब्द अपने आप निकल आता है। नल, फल, घर, तीनों इसी तरह बनते हैं।

characters.name: सोनू कौआ
characters.description: young black crow, glossy feathers, one grey feather on the right wing, wears a small green cloth bag on a strap

scenes.narration: आज दो आवाज़ें जोड़ेंगे, और उनसे एक पूरा शब्द बनेगा।
scenes.caption: Today we join two sounds, and they make one whole word.
scenes.image_brief: Two loose wooden letter blocks lying apart on a kitchen table, one carved with the Hindi letter न and one with ल, a short gap of empty table between them, soft morning light through a window, calm mood.

scenes.narration: पहली आवाज़ न, दूसरी आवाज़ ल। न और ल, दोनों धीरे धीरे बोलो।
scenes.caption: First sound na, second sound la. Na and la, say both slowly.
scenes.image_brief: The same two wooden blocks न and ल now standing upright on the table with a painted arrow on the wood pointing from one towards the other, bright even light, clear and simple.

scenes.narration: अब जल्दी जोड़ो। न ल, नल। रसोई का नल, पानी गिरता है।
scenes.caption: Now join them fast. Na la, nal. The kitchen tap, water falling.
scenes.image_brief: A steel kitchen tap over a sink with a thin stream of water running into a filling brass pot, a card taped to the wall behind showing the Hindi word नल, cool daylight from the window, everyday mood.

scenes.narration: मेरे साथ जोड़ो। न, ल, नल। अब दो बार बोलो।
scenes.caption: Join them with me. Na, la, nal. Now say it twice.
scenes.image_brief: The two blocks न and ल pushed together on the table so they touch, forming नल, with two small pebbles placed in front of them, warm light, inviting mood.

scenes.narration: न और ल, मिलकर नल! दो आवाज़ें जुड़ीं, शब्द बन गया।
scenes.caption: Na and la together make nal! Two sounds joined, a word appeared.
scenes.image_brief: The joined blocks spelling नल standing beside the running kitchen tap, water splashing into the brass pot, a few drops sparkling on the counter, warm light, happy mood.

scenes.narration: अब फ और ल जोड़ो। फ ल, फल। टोकरी भर मीठे फल।
scenes.caption: Now join pha and la. Pha la, phal. A basket full of fruit.
scenes.image_brief: A cane basket heaped with a banana, a guava and two grapes on a kitchen counter, two wooden blocks फ and ल pushed together in front of the basket to read फल, warm afternoon light.

scenes.narration: घ और र जोड़ो। घ र, घर। जोड़ने से नया शब्द मिला।
scenes.caption: Join gha and ra. Gha ra, ghar. Joining gave a new word.
scenes.image_brief: A small blue front door of a house with a stone step and a potted tulsi beside it, two wooden blocks घ and र resting on the step pushed together to read घर, soft late daylight.

scenes.narration: बताओ, न और ल से नल बनता है या फल? नल बनता है।
scenes.caption: Tell me, do na and la make nal or phal? They make nal.
scenes.image_brief: Two cards lying on a kitchen table, one reading नल and one reading फल, with the separate blocks न and ल placed between them, even daylight, curious mood.

scenes.narration: नल, फल, घर, तीनों दो आवाज़ें जोड़कर बने। न और ल, मिलकर नल!
scenes.caption: Nal, phal, ghar, all three built from two joined sounds. Na and la make nal!
scenes.image_brief: Three pairs of wooden blocks lined up on a kitchen table reading नल, फल and घर, each pair pushed tightly together, a brass pot of water at the end of the row, warm evening light.

title: 😌 मीरू बकरी का घर शब्द अधूरा रहा... आख़िरी आवाज़ चूको तो क्या होगा? #hindikids #aawaz
title_alts: 🌟 मीरू बकरी और शब्द की आख़िरी आवाज़... घर का अंत र कैसे पकड़ें? #hindikids #aawaz
🤔 मीरू बकरी ने अंत की आवाज़ छोड़ी... दूध शब्द क्यों गलत बैठता है? #hindikids #aawaz
description_hook: शब्द के अंत में जो आवाज़ बचती है, वही उसे सही लिखवाती है। घर में र, दूध में ध, फूल में ल।

characters.name: मीरू बकरी
characters.description: young white goat kid, two small horn buds, brown patch over the left eye, a blue cloth collar with one bell

scenes.narration: आज सीखेंगे शब्द की आख़िरी आवाज़, अंत वाली आवाज़।
scenes.caption: Today we learn the last sound of a word, the ending sound.
scenes.image_brief: A wooden name board hanging on a house wall with the Hindi word घर painted on it, the final letter र painted twice as thick as the rest, soft morning light across the wall, calm and quiet.

scenes.narration: शब्द के अंत की आवाज़ पकड़ो। घर का अंत र। आख़िरी आवाज़, र।
scenes.caption: Catch the sound at the end of a word. Ghar ends in ra.
scenes.image_brief: A chalk slate leaning on a doorstep with the Hindi word घर written large and a circle drawn around only the last letter र, a stick of chalk beside it, bright even daylight, clear and simple.

scenes.narration: घर बोलो, धीरे धीरे। घ र, र। सुनो, आख़िरी आवाज़ है र।
scenes.caption: Say ghar, slowly. Gha ra, ra. Listen, the last sound is ra.
scenes.image_brief: A small house front with a blue wooden door, a stone step and a potted tulsi, the name board reading घर above the door with its last letter र brighter than the others, warm morning sunlight.

scenes.narration: अब तुम बोलो। घर, और अंत की आवाज़ पकड़ो। दो बार।
scenes.caption: Now you say it. Ghar, and catch the ending sound. Twice over.
scenes.image_brief: Two paper cards resting on a stone doorstep, the upper card showing the whole word घर and the lower card showing only the letter र, a red thread joining them, soft daylight, inviting mood.

scenes.narration: आख़िरी आवाज़ पकड़ी, र मिला! घर का अंत हमेशा र।
scenes.caption: Ending sound caught, we found ra! Ghar always ends in ra.
scenes.image_brief: The card showing the letter र standing upright on the stone doorstep of the blue door, a few marigold petals scattered around it, warm sunlight on the step, pleased and bright mood.

scenes.narration: दूध सुनो, गिलास भर दूध। दू ध, ध। आख़िरी आवाज़ ध।
scenes.caption: Hear doodh, a full glass of milk. Doo dha, dha. It ends in dha.
scenes.image_brief: A tall steel glass of milk filled to the brim on a kitchen shelf, a card propped behind it showing the Hindi word दूध with the final letter ध marked in red, cool morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: फूल बोलो, क्यारी वाला फूल। फू ल, ल। अंत में ल।
scenes.caption: Say phool, the flower from the garden bed. Phoo la, it ends in la.
scenes.image_brief: One open orange marigold on a stem in a small garden bed of loose brown soil, a wooden marker pushed into the soil showing the Hindi word फूल with the final ल in red, bright midday light.

scenes.narration: हाथ बोलो। हा थ, थ। आख़िरी आवाज़ है थ।
scenes.caption: Say haath. Haa tha, tha. The last sound is tha.
scenes.image_brief: A child sized clay handprint plaque drying on a windowsill with the Hindi word हाथ scratched beneath the print and the final letter थ traced deeper, warm afternoon light, homely mood.

scenes.narration: बताओ, दूध की आख़िरी आवाज़ ध है या र? ध है, दूध।
scenes.caption: Tell me, does doodh end in dha or in ra? In dha, doodh.
scenes.image_brief: A glass of milk on a kitchen shelf with two small cards in front of it, the left card showing the letter ध and the right card showing र, even daylight, curious mood.

scenes.narration: घर र, दूध ध, फूल ल, हाथ थ। आख़िरी आवाज़ पकड़ी, र मिला!
scenes.caption: Ghar ra, doodh dha, phool la, haath tha. Ending sound caught, ra found!
scenes.image_brief: Four cards laid in a row on a stone step showing घर, दूध, फूल and हाथ, the last letter of each word inked in the same red, a glass of milk and a marigold set beside the row, golden evening light.

title: 😃 डोली मैना का केला शब्द फिसला... ताली न गिनो तो शब्द आधा क्यों? #hindikids #taali
title_alts: 🎈 डोली मैना ताली से शब्द तोड़ती है... केला में दो ताली कहाँ बजती हैं? #hindikids #taali
😯 डोली मैना की एक ताली छूटी... टुकड़े न गिनो तो रोटी शब्द क्यों बिगड़े? #hindikids #taali
description_hook: शब्द को टुकड़ों में तोड़ो और हर टुकड़े पर एक ताली बजाओ। केला, रोटी, चाबी, ताला, चारों दो ताली वाले हैं।

characters.name: डोली मैना
characters.description: young myna bird, brown body with a yellow beak, one white wing patch, a tiny orange ribbon on her right leg

scenes.narration: आज ताली बजाकर शब्द के टुकड़े गिनेंगे, दो दो टुकड़े।
scenes.caption: Today we clap and count the parts of a word, two parts each.
scenes.image_brief: A ripe yellow banana lying on a wooden kitchen table with two small round wooden discs placed below it in a line, a card beside the banana showing the Hindi word केला split as के ला, bright morning light.

scenes.narration: शब्द तोड़ो, ताली बजाओ। के ला, दो ताली। के ला, केला।
scenes.caption: Break the word, clap it out. Ke la, two claps. Ke la, kela.
scenes.image_brief: A large card standing on a kitchen table showing the Hindi word केला cut into two halves with a gap between के and ला, one wooden disc placed under each half, even bright light, clear and simple.

scenes.narration: केला देखो, पीला लंबा केला। के ला, दो ताली मिलीं।
scenes.caption: Look at kela, a long yellow banana. Ke la, that is two claps.
scenes.image_brief: A single long yellow banana resting in a steel bowl on a wooden kitchen table, two wooden discs set in front of the bowl and a card reading के ला leaning against it, warm morning light, cheerful mood.

scenes.narration: अब तुम बजाओ। के ला। दो ताली, मेरे साथ बोलो, केला।
scenes.caption: Now you clap. Ke la. Two claps, and say it with me, kela.
scenes.image_brief: A pair of small wooden clapper sticks lying on a kitchen table beside the banana and the two wooden discs, the card reading के ला standing upright behind them, bright daylight, inviting mood.

scenes.narration: दो ताली बजी, केला पूरा! हर टुकड़े पर एक ताली।
scenes.caption: Two claps done, kela is complete! One clap for every part.
scenes.image_brief: The two wooden discs now placed side by side touching each other under the card के ला, the yellow banana behind them, small paper stars scattered on the table, warm light, happy mood.

scenes.narration: रोटी भी दो ताली। रो टी। और चाबी भी दो, चा बी।
scenes.caption: Roti is two claps too. Ro ti. And chaabi is two as well.
scenes.image_brief: A warm round roti on a steel plate on a kitchen table with a small brass key lying beside the plate, two cards in front of them reading रो टी and चा बी with a gap in each, soft kitchen light.

scenes.narration: ताला भी दो ताली। ता ला, ताला। दरवाज़े का ताला।
scenes.caption: Taala is two claps as well. Taa la, taala. The door lock.
scenes.image_brief: A heavy iron padlock hanging on the latch of a blue wooden door, a paper tag tied to it reading ता ला with a clear gap between the two parts, late afternoon light on the door.

scenes.narration: बताओ, केला में कितनी ताली, एक या दो? दो ताली, के ला।
scenes.caption: Tell me, how many claps in kela, one or two? Two claps, ke la.
scenes.image_brief: A banana on a wooden table with two cards in front of it, the left card showing one wooden disc and the right card showing two discs in a row, even daylight, curious mood.

scenes.narration: केला, रोटी, चाबी, ताला, चारों में दो ताली। दो ताली बजी, केला पूरा!
scenes.caption: Kela, roti, chaabi, taala, all four take two claps. Two claps, kela done!
scenes.image_brief: Four cards laid in a row on a wooden kitchen table showing के ला, रो टी, चा बी and ता ला, two wooden discs placed under each card, the banana and the padlock at either end of the row, golden evening light.
